software_vs_hardware_estop_definition.software_command_zeroing: Supervisory software gate in user-space (stall_detector_node). Zeros /cmd_vel ROS topic when state estimation / slip divergence is detected. Depends on functioning OS kernel, DDS middleware, and microcontroller firmware.
software_vs_hardware_estop_definition.hardware_emergency_stop: Physical, hard-wired circuit (E-Stop switch / hardware power relay) that physically cuts electrical power to motor drivers and actuator power busses. Operates independently of software, OS, network, or microcontroller health.
